description: Providers review history, document visits, place orders, and review results in the EHR
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergies, medications, and results unavailable); about $240,000 clinic revenue per operating day; 8 hours equals one clinic day
source_evidence: EV-053 (Chief Medical Officer interview); EV-048 (clinic revenue); EV-049 (visit volume); EV-025 (downtime extract)
manual_workaround: Downtime report workstation at each site (hourly read-only extract); paper downtime forms; defer non-urgent visits
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,900 visits per day across 8 clinics; each hour down slows or cancels about 240 visits
quantified_regulatory_impact: Documentation must be completed and back-entered; late entries flagged for compliance review
patient_safety_impact: Severe: missed allergy, medication, or critical result if downtime extracts are stale
ep_416_54_linkage: Not applicable (clinics are not covered by 416.54)

description: Book appointments, check in patients, verify insurance eligibility
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Front-desk flow stops; eligibility errors cause denials (about 4% of claims without real-time checks)
source_evidence: EV-053 (Director of Clinic Operations interview); EV-049 (check-in volume)
manual_workaround: Printed next-day schedules from the downtime workstation; paper registration; payer portal eligibility checks
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,900 check-ins per day; manual registration takes about 3 times longer

description: New prescriptions and refills sent electronically
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients cannot obtain medications; controlled-substance e-prescribing requires the certified EHR module
source_evidence: EV-053 (Chief Medical Officer interview); EV-049 (prescription volume)
manual_workaround: Phone-in or paper prescriptions where state and federal law allow
patient_safety_impact: Severe: therapy interruption for high-risk medications

description: Perioperative documentation, anesthesia records, implant logs, and discharge in the EHR
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cases cannot start without the history and physical, consent, and allergy record; about $88,000 ASC revenue per operating day; CMS emergency preparedness condition
source_evidence: EV-053 (ASC Administrator interview); EV-048 (ASC revenue); EV-049 (case volume); EV-038 (EHR vendor RPO); EV-026 (ASC emergency plan)
manual_workaround: Paper perioperative packet and anesthesia record; cases in progress finish on paper; cancel cases not yet started after 4 hours
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; anesthesia group; implant vendors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Surgeons; anesthesia; ASC nursing; ASC building
quantified_operational_impact: About 28 cases per day across 4 operating rooms; 4 hours down cancels about 14 cases
quantified_regulatory_impact: 42 CFR 416.54 emergency plan must address loss of the medical documentation system; survey deficiency risk
patient_safety_impact: Severe: intraoperative information loss (allergies, implants, anesthesia history)
ep_416_54_linkage: 416.54(a)(1)-(3) plan and continuity of operations; 416.54(b)(4) medical documentation system that preserves, protects, and keeps records available

business_process: Medication administration and infusion (smart pumps and drug library)
description: Infusion pumps use a drug library pushed from the pump server over the ASC device VLAN
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pumps keep running on the last loaded library; network loss stops library updates and pump status monitoring
source_evidence: EV-053 (ASC Director of Nursing interview); EV-018 (pump server outside backup scope); EV-026 (ASC emergency plan)
manual_workaround: Manual pump programming with independent double-check by a second nurse; paper medication administration record
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (ASC infusion pumps and pump server); SYS-05 (ASC)
quantified_operational_impact: About 60 infusions per day; double-checks add about 5 minutes each
quantified_regulatory_impact: 416.54 plan does not address pump network loss today (EV-026)
patient_safety_impact: Severe: wrong-dose risk if manual programming is not double-checked
ep_416_54_linkage: 416.54(a)(2) strategies for emergency events from the all-hazards risk assessment; 416.54(d) training and testing

description: Schedule cases, collect consents, pre-admission testing, and prior authorization status
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Next-day cases need confirmed pre-admission records; can run 1 day from printed schedules
manual_workaround: Printed 3-day schedule and pre-admission packets kept at the ASC
quantified_operational_impact: About 28 cases per day scheduled 2-14 days ahead
ep_416_54_linkage: 416.54(c)(4) method for sharing medical documentation with other providers

business_process: Imaging acquisition and reading (MRI, CT, X-ray)
description: Acquire studies at modalities, store in PACS, read in RIS/PACS, AI triage worklist
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $48,000 imaging revenue per operating day; emergency-referred CT studies need same-day reads; modalities hold about 3 days of studies locally
source_evidence: EV-053 (Imaging Center Director interview); EV-048 (imaging revenue); EV-049 (study volume)
manual_workaround: Modalities store locally; radiologists read at modality consoles for urgent studies; divert non-urgent studies to the joint reading group
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-04 (workloads account); SYS-05 (imaging center); SYS-07 (modalities)
dependent_third_parties: PACS vendor; teleradiology reading group; cloud provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 160 studies per day; after 12 hours about 80 studies wait for reads
quantified_regulatory_impact: Delayed critical result communication to referring providers
patient_safety_impact: Severe: delayed read of a critical finding (for example intracranial hemorrhage)
ep_416_54_linkage: Not applicable (imaging center is not an ASC)

description: Send reports and images to referring providers and the EHR through the interface engine
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Referring providers need reports within 24 hours for routine studies; critical results are phoned
source_evidence: EV-053 (Imaging Center Director interview); EV-022 (PACS interface)
manual_workaround: Radiologists phone critical results; fax reports
quantified_regulatory_impact: Critical result communication policy; accreditation expectations

description: Send lab orders and receive results through the interface engine
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Critical results must reach providers; the reference laboratory phones critical values
source_evidence: EV-053 (Chief Medical Officer interview); EV-022 (laboratory interfaces)
manual_workaround: Lab portal and fax; the lab phones critical results

description: Charge capture, claim scrubbing, submission, and eligibility through the clearinghouse
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $1.9 million expected collections per week; payers accept late claims within filing limits
source_evidence: EV-053 (Director of Revenue Cycle interview); EV-042 (clearinghouse agreement; $1.9 million a week); EV-049 (claims volume)
manual_workaround: Queue claims; submit high-dollar claims through payer portals; draw on the revolving credit line
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,600 claims per day queue; about $1.14 million of cash is delayed at the 72-hour MTD (delayed, not lost)

business_process: Payment posting, patient billing, and collections
description: Post remittances, patient statements, card payments through the point-to-point encryption solution
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Posting can lag several days without loss; statements are monthly
source_evidence: EV-053 (Director of Revenue Cycle interview); EV-042 (remittance through the clearinghouse); EV-040 (card processing agreement)
manual_workaround: Hold statements; accept card payments on the standalone point-to-point encryption terminals

description: Request and track payer authorizations for ASC, imaging, and specialty services (AI-004 automation)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: ASC and imaging cases without authorization are rescheduled; staff can work payer portals manually at lower volume
source_evidence: EV-053 (Director of Revenue Cycle interview); EV-049 (authorization volume); EV-050 (AI-004)
manual_workaround: Manual submission through payer portals and phone; prioritize cases within 72 hours
quantified_operational_impact: About 350 authorization requests per day; manual capacity is about 60% of volume

business_process: Patient communications (portal, call center, website chatbot, telehealth)
description: Portal messages, phones, website chatbot (AI-005), and telehealth visits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients need to reach the practice; portal messages include clinical questions
source_evidence: EV-053 (Director of Patient Access interview); EV-049 (call and portal volume); EV-050 (AI-005)
manual_workaround: Phone tree to mobile phones; post a website banner; route clinical questions to nurse line
dependent_third_parties: Portal (EHR vendor); telephony provider; chatbot vendor
quantified_operational_impact: About 4,500 calls and 2,000 portal messages per day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Patient access and information blocking expectations

description: Inbound and outbound referrals, records requests, health information exchange
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Referral timeliness affects care and joint venture commitments
source_evidence: EV-053 (Director of Clinic Operations interview); EV-022 (health information exchange interface)
manual_workaround: Fax and phone; paper referral log
dependent_third_parties: Health information exchange; cloud fax vendor
quantified_regulatory_impact: Records request response timelines under the Privacy Rule
ep_416_54_linkage: 416.54(c)(4) sharing medical documentation with other providers (ASC referrals)

description: Data warehouse feeds quality measures, payer reporting, and PE sponsor dashboards
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reporting deadlines are weeks away; the data warehouse can be rebuilt from the EHR
source_evidence: EV-053 (Chief Financial Officer interview); EV-017 (data warehouse)
manual_workaround: Delay internal dashboards; use EHR standard reports for urgent payer requests

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding and termination, credentialing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missing payroll has legal and retention impact; credentialing lapses stop provider billing
source_evidence: EV-053 (Chief Financial Officer interview); EV-003 (HR roster)
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider; manual credentialing tracker
quantified_regulatory_impact: Wage payment laws; payer credentialing rules

description: Order supplies, track implants and lot numbers for recalls
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Par levels cover about 3 days of cases; implant lot tracking is needed for recalls
manual_workaround: Paper implant log; phone orders to distributors
